technical.summary: Short-term momentum signals (RSI9, Hull flip, golden cross) show bullish structure, but lack trend strength (ADX 15), volume confirmation (CMF negative), and long-term support (below SMA200); moderate risk swing entry with pullback vulnerability.

fundamental.summary: QRVO shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and faces earnings in 23 days with no fundamental tailwinds.

sentiment.summary: No composite congressional signal; recent trades by junior member Ro Khanna are small-sized and mixed (2 sales, 1 purchase over 6 months); broad market sentiment neutral with slight bearish bias (42% bearish vs 21% bullish); insufficient data to establish directional conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (215.5) indicates extreme market stress, and earnings event in 23 days adds binary risk to QRVO position.

debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels), lack of volume/trend confirmation (ADX weak, CMF negative, below SMA200), zero fundamental conviction, and earnings binary risk in 23 days overwhelm short-term technicals.
